calculation.description: Ranks assets positively when they are deeply below their 60-session high, scaled by recent 20-session realized volatility; signal is lagged one completed session and predicts 5-session forward returns.

validation.regime_notes: Positive 5-session IC across the full synthetic cross-asset history; conservative interpretation warranted because the cross-section averages 11 instruments and factor coverage is 28.2% due to warmup/volatility requirements. Daily 1-session admission gate failed: ICIR 0.077159 < 0.0840, so not admitted despite stronger 5-session diagnostics.
